81:t_2:28.en:
$$レイカ$$
「The civilians were scattered over a wide area, and only a few members of the organizations connected to the $$トップレス$$ seem to have arrived. We don't have the full picture.」

81:t_2:29.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Apparently, humanity on their Earth operated throughout the solar system.」

81:t_2:30.en:
$$キャシー$$
「With the restoration of space-time on $$蒼の地球$$, the solar systems of $$蒼の地球$$ and $$翠の地球$$ have now merged, but...」

81:t_2:31.en:
$$レイカ$$
「We don't currently know what's happened to their facilities on the various planets.」

81:t_2:32.en:
$$レイカ$$
「But they... the $$トップレス$$, continue to fight the mysterious $$宇宙怪獣$$ in this world as well.」

81:t_2:33.en:
$$レイカ$$
「More precisely, they focus exclusively on that mission and make no effort to contact people from other worlds.」

81:t_2:34.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I see... $$蒼の地球$$ was also attacked by $$宇宙怪獣$$. So $$翠の地球$$ suffered the same thing.」

81:t_2:35.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But the type we fought today wasn't even in the data $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ provided.」

81:t_2:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The name '$$宇宙怪獣$$' is a general term. We can't conclude that they're the same species.」

81:t_2:37.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The issue is that other beings like the $$宇宙怪獣$$ we know existed as well.」

81:t_2:38.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Then it seems the $$宇宙怪獣$$ attacking $$翠の地球$$ haven't appeared on $$蒼の地球$$.」

81:t_2:39.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But it's only a matter of time.」

81:t_2:40.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Unfortunately, I agree. With so many $$宇宙怪獣$$ entering the atmosphere, their attacks will only intensify.」

81:t_2:41.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We need information on these new $$宇宙怪獣$$. Can you contact those $$トップレス$$?」

81:t_2:42.en:
$$レイカ$$
「We've tried several times, but unfortunately...」

81:t_2:43.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Still, when you think about it, you've got to respect them. They're willingly fighting to protect Earth without asking for anything in return.」

81:t_2:44.en:
$$キャシー$$
「With that much firepower, it'd be wonderful if they'd help us fight $$サイデリアル$$, too...」

81:t_2:45.en:
$$レイカ$$
「We've asked them about that as well, but received no response.」

81:t_2:46.en:
$$レイカ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ apparently also treats the $$トップレス$$ as an organization that only fights $$宇宙怪獣$$ and leaves them alone.」

81:t_2:47.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If we can't get their help, we'll fight with the forces we have.」

81:t_2:48.en:
$$レイカ$$
「The resistance groups on the $$アメリア$$ Continent are already gathering for the assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

81:t_2:49.en:
$$レイカ$$
「You'll be their core force, breaking through at a single point to seize the enemy base.」

81:t_2:50.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's the kind of operation we do best.」

81:t_2:51.en:
$$レイカ$$
「$$破嵐$$ told me about $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$. With your roots in $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, I believe you'll make this operation a success.」

81:t_2:52.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$レイカ$$... Please coordinate with the resistance groups for our strategy meeting.」

81:t_2:53.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Understood. Please move the ship to the coordinates I'll give you.」

81:t_2:54.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's finally time to kick $$サイデリアル$$ off $$翠の地球$$!」

81:t_2:55.en:
$$勝平$$
「We've fought them to a stalemate on the Central Continent. Destroy their base on the $$アメリア$$ Continent, and Earth will have the upper hand.」

81:t_2:56.en:
$$甲児$$
「Once we cut off their reinforcements here, we'll head back to $$蒼の地球$$...」

81:t_2:57.en:
$$アルト$$
「Once we've freed $$翠の地球$$, $$蒼の地球$$ is next.」

81:t_2:58.en:
$$勝平$$
「We'll be coming with you then, and so will Big Bro $$レド$$.」

81:t_2:59.en:
$$勝平$$
「We let those $$トップレス$$ get away, but with us around, we'll kick $$サイデリアル$$ off $$蒼の地球$$ in no time!」

81:t_2:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「That look on your face isn't very convincing.」

81:t_2:66.en:
$$マオ$$
「Your feelings show on your face more than you realize these days.」

81:t_2:67.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's right. If you're worried about ending your two-timing, you can always talk to me.」

81:t_2:68.en:
$n
「Just for reference, what would you do?」

81:t_2:69.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Leave one of them to me.」

81:t_2:74.en:
$n
「Thank you, $$クルツ$$. I'll keep that in mind.」

81:t_2:75.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's a great smile. With the right training, you could be my successor and inherit everything I know.」

81:t_2:76.en:
$n
「Your successor...? I'm... not much of a sniper, though...」

81:t_2:77.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I don't mean that. I'm talking about nighttime sniping.」

81:t_2:78.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's enough. Miss $$スズネ$$ is glaring at you from over there.」

81:t_2:79.en:
$$マオ$$
「At this rate, she might go back to that hysterical state she was in before.」

81:t_2:82.en:
$$宗介$$
「Are you feeling a little less worried?」

81:t_2:83.en:
$n
「...Yeah. It feels stupid to be afraid of some vague anxiety.」

81:t_2:84.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's the spirit. Needless fear clouds your judgment.」

81:t_2:86.en:
$n
(That's right... Instead of fearing my anxiety, I'll find the will to overcome it...)

81:t_2:87.en:
$n
(The assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$... We absolutely have to make it succeed...)

81:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...According to my information, the $$宇宙怪獣$$ we fought today are called Twin-Tail class.」

81:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The other day we fought giant shrimp, and today we fought Twin-Tails...」

81:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My gourmet sensors are reacting to something, but I can't work out the answer.」

81:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... That's the limit of my dull wits, I suppose.」

81:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get cracking today, too... Business, business!」

82:t_000:0.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「She summoned her machine with spatial teleportation!? How does that work!?」

82:t_000:1.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「S-She's...! One of those $$トップレス$$ we've heard about!」

82:t_000:2.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「But... I heard we had a nonaggression pact with them...!」

82:t_000:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't care what the regular military decided. I'm with 《$$フラタニティ$$》.」

82:t_000:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Besides, you're the ones who broke the treaty.」

82:t_000:5.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「When did we ever lay a finger on you!?」

82:t_000:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're making a racket right in front of me. It's an eyesore.」

82:t_001:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So you brought out your machines... If you'd just backed off, I'd have let you go.」

82:t_001:1.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「$$トップレス$$ or whatever, you're still just an Earthling!」

82:t_001:2.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Show everyone in town what happens to people who defy $$サイデリアル$$!」

82:t_001:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're small fry through and through...」

82:t_002:1.en:
$$店長$$
「Could that be... a 《$$トップレス$$》...?」
